sources: https://www.parks.ca.gov/?page_id=476 (Benicia SRA, read 2026-11-27): 'Three "Enroute" campsites are available for an overnight stay on a "first-come, first-served" basis with no reservations possible. This camping is limited to motorhomes or vehicles with trailers, which must be fully self-contained. Tents are not permitted.'; 'Reservation Availability: No upcoming camping/lodging reservations at this time.'; 'Park Hours Daily: 8am - Sunset'; '(707) 648-1911'; 'Vehicle Day Use: $6.00'; 'Restrooms', 'Drinking Water Available'; 'Construction in Progress ... In the picnic area work includes a complete remodel of the restroom facility ... Completion is projected for mid-May 2027.'; no closure banner

https://www.parks.ca.gov/pages/476/files/007.25.680.680%20District%20Camping%20Limits%20ADA.pdf (Diablo Range District order, effective 2026-01-01): '"Enroute Camping" is allowed at designated sites within the Benicia State Recreation Area. Authorized occupation of the site is for only one night from 4:00 p.m. to 9:00 a.m. daily. Persons occupying the site for such camping shall vacate the campground by 9:00 a.m. the following morning and shall vacate for a period of 48 hours before returning for another stay.'

https://www.parks.ca.gov/pages/476/files/BeniciaFinalWebLayout2018.pdf (park brochure, 2018): 'Tent camping is not permitted. For a fee, RVs may camp en route for one night, space permitting, near the park entrance.' (no amount)

note: En route overnight camping for fully self-contained motorhomes and trailers only (no tents) in the day-use area near the park entrance off Columbus Pkwy by I-780, space permitting. A fee is charged ($12 a night per an earlier read; the park pages give no figure). --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov + district order: 3 en route self-contained RV spaces, FCFS, one night 4 p.m.-9 a.m., no ReserveCalifornia listing; no closure (restroom remodel to mid-May 2027). Fee amount not posted. Not waterfront kept; pin fine.
flags: CRITERIA QUESTION (en route / day-use lot): camping is three designated en route spaces in the day-use area 'near the park entrance' under 14 CCR 4457 'One-Night Camping in Day Use Areas', self-contained rigs only, one night. The Montana-round lesson says 'a day-use site where camping means the parking lot is not a campground'; this is agency-designated overnight RV camping (numbered by the district order), so read as a keep, but the reviewer may want to rule on it.

FEES: no camping fee is posted on parks.ca.gov, the 2018 brochure ('For a fee') or ReserveCalifornia; the note's $12 is from an earlier unsourced read and is kept in the note as such. Day-use vehicle fee $6.
CONSTRUCTION: restroom remodel in the picnic area to mid-May 2027 (park page); not a camping closure.
No rig length is posted (no ReserveCalifornia units). PHONE (707) 648-1911 and WEBSITE page_id=476 confirmed.
Waterfront 'not waterfront' kept: tidal marsh begins south of the park road; open Carquinez Strait water is ~1 km off.
Policy row state:CA (ReserveCalifornia) does not apply - booking overridden to first-come above.
